SessionStart.description: Restore previous session context + load project memory and evolved skills (plain stdout becomes developer context)

hooks.command: EH=$(command -v epic 2>/dev/null); test -n "$EH" && "$EH" guard || echo '[harness] epic not found'

PreToolUse.description: Block dangerous commands (force push, prod DB drop, rm -rf /)

hooks.command: EH=$(command -v epic 2>/dev/null); test -n "$EH" && "$EH" observe || echo '[harness] epic not found'

PostToolUse.description: Record every tool result for the evolution loop — Bash, apply_patch and MCP tools alike ('*' matches all)

hooks.command: EH=$(command -v epic 2>/dev/null); test -n "$EH" && "$EH" polish || echo '[harness] epic not found'

PostToolUse.description: Auto-format + typecheck after edits (Codex edits arrive as apply_patch)

hooks.command: EH=$(command -v epic 2>/dev/null); test -n "$EH" && "$EH" snapshot || echo '[harness] epic not found'

PreCompact.description: Save working state before context compaction so resume can restore it

hooks.command: EH=$(command -v epic 2>/dev/null); test -n "$EH" && "$EH" reflect || echo '[harness] epic not found'

SessionEnd.description: Analyze session observations -> evolve skills -> gate mutations (session-scoped; Stop fires once per turn)
